content.comment_body: Hello, I am new to [product_name] and learning the basics. Currently, I am working with model [article_no]. My goal is to read the analog input from a potentiometer. I have set up the analog input (AI1) to an analog amplifier (0...10V) and connected everything as specified. The potentiometer's middle terminal is connected to I7 (AI1), and one of the side terminals is attached to L+; it does not seem to matter which side. However, my readings are between 700 and 1000, not from 0 to 1000. I checked the potentiometer resistance with a multimeter, and it ranges from 0 to 25k ohms. My question is, are there any settings or wiring approaches I should adjust to get the full proper range? I am not sure what the exact issue is. Any help would be much appreciated. Thank you.

Please share your program so we can review what might be incorrect. Make sure you are using three wires to connect the potentiometer: one side to the + (maximum 12 Volt), the other side to - (ground), and the middle terminal to the A1 input of the [product_name]. Remember that it only works with up to 10 Volt input, and the analog input should not exceed 12 Volt.
I got it working, thank you. Your advice to use a separate 10 Volt power supply for the potentiometer was correct.
